thesis: The episode argues that for allocators, the critical challenge is not just making individual professionals more productive, but leveraging firm-level opportunities to surface deals earlier, activate relationships at the right moment, and accelerate diligence. The discussion frames the upcoming NFL draft as a parallel exercise to investing, focusing on the common goal of identifying the next generation of talent through evidence-based judgment under uncertainty.
